name: diy-battery-bms-web-flasher
description: Browser flasher for DIY Battery BMS - builds into ../site

scripts.pages: npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy ../site --project-name diy-power-pilot-uk --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run restore && npm run manifests && npm run release && npm run pages && npm run prune-deployments
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && npm run restore -- --all && npm run manifests && npm run pages && npm run prune-deployments
